 CIELO’s Clear Jello Blush Makes a Comeback With a New Bestie This December
 Angelica Sarte on November 17 2026 - 10:18 am 
 Share on Facebook 
 CIELO Girls have more reasons to get excited this December as CIELO brings back its much-loved Clear Jello Blush, with another product joining the collection!
 After officially selling out, the fan-favorite blush is set to return in the first week of December, giving customers another chance to get their hands on it.
 More to Love 
 CIELO’s Clear Jello Blush has become a favorite for its lightweight, translucent jelly balm formula designed for both lips and cheeks. Its color-adapting pigments develop into a soft pink flush upon application, adding a subtle touch of color to everyday looks.
 Aside from the blush’s much-awaited return, CIELO Girls also have another reason to get excited. This time, the product will be joined by a new addition to the collection, giving customers another beauty find to look forward to.
 With the holiday season just around the corner, the returning blush and its newest companion could also make lovely gifts for beauty-loving friends and family, or even serve as a little treat for yourself.
 For those planning to shop this December, CIELO reminds customers to purchase only through its official TikTok and Shopee accounts. 
 Stay Tuned 
 Explore CIELO’s collection through its official Shopee and TikTok Shop pages. For more updates on its latest releases and beauty essentials, follow CIELO on Instagram
